column1: # Build-time switch registry (tools/ci/switches.py checks it, CI job "hygiene"). Engine switches are in
# ps2/proto/src/switches.h; this file holds the rest: scope make = a variable of ps2/proto/Makefile (a ?= default, or one
# the recipe reads but never sets); scope env = an environment variable a tool in tools/ reads.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, scope, default, kind, owner, off, pr, where, what
#   kind   flag (0 / 1), tune (a number), debug (logs, checks, dumps), opt (unset unless given), config (paths, tool
#          and job settings, not a code path)
#   owner  the Polaris module the switch belongs to (tools/ci/switches.py OWNERS)
#   off    the value that selects the other / old path; - = none
#   pr     the PR that added it: #N, init (first public release), c:<commit> (a direct commit), or new until the
# A new make variable or environment read needs a row here; "python3 -I tools/ci/switches.py --tsv" prints the whole
# registry (engine and build-time) as one table.
